baseline.policy: Build a native ARM64 macOS app first, then convert with macos-on-ios; do not compile the game engine for iPhoneOS.

preserve: Approved cover crop and iPhone icon catalog
iPhone native resolution, aspect ratio and safe-area presentation
Korean code variants, font UV correction, subtitle switching, spacing and punctuation
Korean sprite alignment and approved settings lettering
User saves and original imported game files
Original macOS logger, recorder and F7 behavior
exclude: Existing iPhoneOS game target, SDL UIKit entry point and device engine build
Existing iOS scheduler, audio-mailbox and render/presenter changes
Old Smooth Motion scene adapter in the initial baseline
Cache-copy timing acceleration and producer-vblank bypass
Additional port diagnostic files, probes and shader dumps
unknowns: macOS-on-iOS compatibility and actual attract-demo stutter need device validation
Original macOS launcher execv and separate Qt installer require conversion-safe entry/import handling
Korean hooks must be rebuilt into the macOS app; a binary-only conversion does not carry them
Smooth Motion is absent in pristine baseline and requires a separate implementation decision
source_safety: Never commit private game files, generated C, device logs or credentials. Do not delete or overwrite existing saves/cache to test.
first_ipa: 60fps, no Smooth Motion, no stutter tuning before device baseline
validation: Shader compiler/cache/prewarm and shader source identity check passed
Language hooks and layout compile passed
